title: The Coughing Horse
offer: Your first case as healers: Ragnfrid's old horse Bror coughs. Take him this syrup of thyme and honey, then come back to me after a night, to hear how he is.

steps.say: Thyme and honey? Bror loves it. He licks the spoon!
He slept the whole night and coughs no more. Tell Tova: her apprentices are good!
Well done! You listened, you waited, you looked. That is healing.

fact: Honey helps a sore throat, for horses as for people.
